title: The Holy Spirit Helps Us Live Well
opening: The work of the Holy Spirit is seen not only in powerful moments but also in a life growing in love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, and self-control.
points: Ask the Spirit to shape your character and daily responses.
Measure spiritual growth by Christlike fruit, not attention or status.
Practise patience, kindness, and self-control in ordinary relationships.
reflection: Which fruit of the Spirit could you practise intentionally today?
prayer: Holy Spirit, guide me in truth and grow Your fruit in my life. Help my conduct point people toward Jesus. Amen.
ministry: Grace Fire Deliverance Healing Global Word Ministry
author: Daily Bible Teaching Team
